item.title: Overview of 2 Chronicles - A Kingdom of Glory and a Kingdom in Ruins 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story A kingdom that begins in blinding glory and ends in choking smoke, that is the emotional sweep of 2 Chronicles. If you’ve read the book, you can still feel the contrast. Picture the opening scene: Solomon, robed in splendour, kneels before the altar as thousands watch in breathless silence. He finishes praying, and suddenly fire falls from heaven, consuming the sacrifice. A thick cloud of God’s glory floods the temple so intensely that even the priests cannot enter. The people fall on their faces, overwhelmed by the nearness of God.
